name: refactor_java_extract_username_validator
description: Extracts duplicated username validation from two Java services into a shared validator, preserving behavior
prompts: SignupService and ProfileService (in src/main/java/com/optarena/) both contain the same inline username validation: trim (treating null as empty), then require the length to be between 3 and 20 inclusive. Refactor to remove the duplication: create src/main/java/com/optarena/UsernameValidator.java with a method isValid(String) implementing exactly that rule, and have both services use it instead of their inline check. Do not change observable behavior - a 3-character name like "Bob" stays valid ("registered:bob"), "ab" and a 21-char name stay "invalid", null stays "invalid", and the "registered:"/"updated:" prefixes plus lower-casing are unchanged. Neither service should still contain the inline `u.length() < 3` check.
